sanskrit_verse: क्रमाद् अव्याहतं प्राप्तं पुत्रैर् यन् नर्णम् उद्धृतम् । दद्युः पैतामहं पौत्रास् तच् चतुर्थान् निवर्तते ॥
transliteration: kramād avyāhataṃ prāptaṃ putrair yan narṇam uddhṛtam | dadyuḥ paitāmahaṃ pautrās tac caturthān nivartate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That wealth which is acquired in regular succession and without impediment by sons shall be given to the paternal grandfather by the grandsons; this cycles back at the fourth generation.
jurisprudential_principles: Restoration logic maintains familial economic continuity
Consciousness alignment occurs through dharmic generational transfer
executable_legal_axioms: IF wealth is received by a son WITHOUT obstruction THEN it MUST be transferred to his father upon the son's departure
IF a grandson receives wealth INHERITED FROM grandfather THEN he MUST offer a portion TO HIS FATHER’S FATHER after four generational cycles
GENERATIONAL WEALTH TRANSFER is AUTOMATICALLY VALIDATED when KRAMA (order) IS MAINTAINED
INHERITANCE CYCLE RESTARTS every FOUR GENERATIONS ensuring no stagnation of resources
supreme_court_application: In matters of intergenerational property rights, the Supreme Court must recognize the automatic validity of transfers occurring in krama (succession). Responsibility lies not in ownership but in maintaining the flow of dharma-authorized circulation. The fourth-generation reset ensures societal resource balance while honoring ancestral lineage integrity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that uninterrupted receipt creates binding obligation. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that dharma manifests sequentially through generations. Proportionality is maintained via cyclical redistribution rather than punitive seizure. This reflects the non-punitive reality rule where justice is alignment, not correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-establish unbroken chain of offering from grandson to grandfather
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Grandson acknowledges role as temporary custodian
Capacity Restoration: Elder lineage is supported to maintain spiritual-economic function
Integrity Reintegration: Family unit realigned with cyclic dharma-based wealth flow
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism as Source-Law: Wealth moves in sacred cycle, neither owned nor hoarded but offered. Dharma is restored through conscious circulation. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
